responsibility: Declares the callback-based walking API for traversing GIMPLE statements, sequences, and load/store/address operands. It defines walk_stmt_info for carrying traversal state and replacement constraints and exposes the walk_gimple_* and walk_stmt_load_store_* entry points used by front-end lowering and pre-SSA analyses or transformations.
same_name_distinction: Public API header for GIMPLE walking, defining walk_stmt_info and walker callback/prototype interfaces; the actual traversal behavior and special-case handling for statements and operands live in gcc/gimple-walk.cc.
